name: Klara – Publish Jacob weekly plan to Home Assistant

parameters.query:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT wp.*
  FROM weekly_plans wp
  JOIN people p ON p.person_id = wp.person_id
  WHERE p.external_key = 'jacob' AND wp.processing_status = 'processed'
  ORDER BY wp.plan_week_start DESC NULLS LAST, wp.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'plan', (SELECT row_to_json(latest) FROM latest),
  'homework', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(h) ORDER BY h.due_date NULLS LAST, h.homework_id) FROM weekly_plan_homework h JOIN latest p ON p.weekly_plan_id = h.weekly_plan_id), '[]'::json),
  'events', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(e) ORDER BY e.event_date NULLS LAST, e.start_time NULLS LAST, e.event_id) FROM weekly_plan_events e JOIN latest p ON p.weekly_plan_id = e.weekly_plan_id), '[]'::json),
  'reminders', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r) ORDER BY r.reminder_date NULLS LAST, r.reminder_id) FROM weekly_plan_reminders r JOIN latest p ON p.weekly_plan_id = r.weekly_plan_id), '[]'::json),
  'topics', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.topic_id) FROM weekly_plan_topics t JOIN latest p ON p.weekly_plan_id = t.weekly_plan_id), '[]'::json),
  'messages', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(m) ORDER BY m.message_id) FROM weekly_plan_messages m JOIN latest p ON p.weekly_plan_id = m.weekly_plan_id), '[]'::json),
  'schedule', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(s) ORDER BY s.weekday, s.start_time, s.schedule_id) FROM weekly_plan_schedule s JOIN latest p ON p.weekly_plan_id = s.weekly_plan_id), '[]'::json)
) AS data;
